headline: SL Green Reports Q3 EPS of $1.01 and Raises Full-Year Guidance
summary: SL Green Realty posted third-quarter EPS of $1.01 and funds from operations of $1.59 per share, while lifting its 2026 earnings outlook.
why: SL Green is Manhattan's largest office landlord, making its financial performance a bellwether for New York City commercial office real estate.

impacts.name: SL Green Realty
impacts.why: Raising full-year guidance signals leasing momentum and stable occupancy across Manhattan properties.
